finite_residue_component: For each fixed (s,r), the Pell-unit matrix has finite order modulo 2a; powers congruent to identity preserve the affine lattice residue and generate residue-compatible ambient Pell orbits.

no_pure_residue_automaton_claim.scope: This excludes a congruence-only finite automaton for full branch reachability; it does not exclude richer symbolic/continued-fraction state machines.
no_pure_residue_automaton_claim.statement: No eventual rule depending only on k modulo a fixed M can reproduce the full nonsquare mechanical child phase: floor(sqrt(r)(k+M)+beta)-floor(sqrt(r)k+beta) takes both adjacent values because M sqrt(r) is irrational; Pell-strip defects are O(log K) and cannot remove the two positive-density mechanical phase classes.

reachability_component: Residue/Pell-orbit membership is necessary but not sufficient for endpoint-branch reachability. Exact reachability is certified by repeated predecessor() checks against the integer child oracle.
